verdict.rationale: Rolling back a system after a bad update is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents system snapshots, Time Machine restore, or rolling back an update. The only recovery-related item covers recovering a deleted password, which is an unrelated feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can roll back the system to a previous snapshot if an update breaks something
